name: Sparse Voxel Octree Ray Casting with Distance Fields
aliases: Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) Ray Casting with Distance Fields
definition: A rendering method that ray-casts directly against a Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) using distance fields to render isosurfaces, avoiding conversion to polygonal geometry. It uses a hybrid octree structure: an octree down to a certain level, then bricks of voxels for the final levels.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree Ray Casting with Distance Fields renders isosurfaces by ray-casting against a hybrid octree with leaf bricks, offering GPU scalability for planetary scales unlike standard sparse voxel octree ray tracing.
